meta: Every new chat, you have to explain again: "I teach 8th grade, keep it short"? Claude has two places that help it remember: Projects and Memory. Here's how to use them and keep control.

muc.title: Explaining from scratch every time
muc.text: Every new chat, you have to explain everything from scratch? Claude has two places that help it remember: Projects and Memory.

muc.title: A workroom for one task
muc.text: A Project is a private workroom for one task. You upload documents and set instructions once, and every chat inside shares them.

muc.title: Each room has its own memory
muc.text: The free plan lets you create five Projects. Each Project also has its own memory, so class stuff doesn't mix with family stuff.

muc.title: Settings, Memory
muc.text: Outside Projects, Claude remembers general things about you on its own: your job, how you like answers. Go to Settings, then Memory, to view, edit or delete each line.

muc.title: Pause, wipe, incognito
muc.text: You can pause memory or wipe it completely. For private matters, open an incognito chat: no history saved, nothing goes into memory.

muc.title: See what Claude remembers about you
muc.text: Open Settings, then Memory, and read what Claude remembers about you. If a line is wrong, edit it or delete it.

muc.title: Teach Claude a process
muc.text: To go deeper, rewatch videos 27 and 29 on the channel. Part 5: teach Claude a whole process, with Skills.
